scenarios.title: Guest scans QR code with French browser - displays French content
steps: 1. Guest has browser set to French (fr-FR)
2. Guest scans QR code linking to /item/abc123
3. System detects Accept-Language: fr-FR header
4. Page loads with item content in French
5. TranslationBanner displays 'Translated from English'
6. LanguageIndicator shows French flag and 'Francais'
expected_results: Content displays in French when translation exists
TranslationBanner is visible with source language info
View Original toggle is available
FAQBNB_GUEST_LANG cookie is set to 'fr'

scenarios.title: Guest manually switches language using GuestLanguageSwitcher
steps: 1. Guest is viewing item page in English
2. Guest clicks on GuestLanguageSwitcher dropdown
3. Guest sees all 6 languages (en, fr, es, de, nl, it)
4. Languages with available translations show checkmark
5. Guest selects German (Deutsch)
6. Content updates to German without page reload
expected_results: Dropdown shows all 6 languages with flags and native names
Available translations are marked with checkmark
Content updates instantly (client-side toggle)
Cookie is updated to 'de'
TranslationBanner updates to show 'Translated from English'

scenarios.title: Guest toggles View Original to see original content
steps: 1. Guest is viewing translated content in French
2. TranslationBanner shows 'Translated from English - View original'
3. Guest clicks 'View original' link in banner
4. Content instantly switches to original English
5. ViewOriginalToggle button shows 'View translation'
expected_results: Content switches instantly without page reload
ViewOriginalToggle shows correct state
TranslationBanner is hidden when showing original
Guest can toggle back to translated content

scenarios.title: Guest accesses shareable link with language parameter
steps: 1. Guest receives shared link /item/abc123?lang=es
2. Guest's browser is set to English
3. Guest opens the shared link
4. System prioritizes URL parameter over browser setting
5. Content displays in Spanish
expected_results: URL parameter takes highest priority for language
Content displays in Spanish despite English browser
Cookie is updated to 'es' for future visits
Canonical URL does NOT include ?lang= parameter

scenarios.title: Guest returns to site with saved language preference
steps: 1. Guest previously selected German as preferred language
2. FAQBNB_GUEST_LANG cookie is set to 'de'
3. Guest scans a different QR code for new item
4. Browser sends cookie with request
5. Middleware detects cookie preference
expected_results: Content displays in German (from cookie)
Cookie preference overrides browser Accept-Language
Guest's language preference persists across sessions
Cookie has 1-year expiry

scenarios.title: Guest views item with translations for all content types
steps: 1. Guest views item page with translations available
2. Item has name, description, articles, links, and tags
3. Guest selects French as display language
4. All content types display in French
expected_results: Item name displays in French
Item description displays in French
Article titles and descriptions display in French
Link titles display in French (URLs unchanged)
Tags display translated values

scenarios.title: Guest views language availability via API
steps: 1. Guest or client app requests /api/public/items/{publicId}/languages
2. API returns language availability information
3. Response includes source language and available translations
expected_results: API returns LanguageAvailabilityResponse format
sourceLanguage field shows original content language
availableTranslations lists languages with completed translations
pendingTranslations lists languages in progress
unavailableTranslations lists remaining languages

scenarios.title: Guest accesses item via public API with language parameter
steps: 1. Client app requests /api/public/items/{publicId}?lang=fr
2. API fetches item with French translation
3. API returns GuestContentResponse format
expected_results: API returns translated item content in French
translationMeta includes requestedLanguage, displayLanguage, sourceLanguage
translationMeta.isShowingTranslation is true
translationMeta.availableTranslations lists all available languages

scenarios.title: Guest views item on mobile device
steps: 1. Guest opens item page on mobile phone (320px width)
2. GuestLanguageSwitcher displays in compact mode
3. TranslationBanner displays without obscuring content
4. Guest taps language switcher
5. Dropdown opens with touch-friendly target sizes
expected_results: Language switcher is responsive and compact on mobile
Dropdown items have minimum 44x44px touch targets
Banner does not obscure main content
All interactive elements are easily tappable

scenarios.title: Guest experiences fast page load with translation
steps: 1. Guest scans QR code for item with translations
2. Measure time for language detection
3. Measure time for content with translation to load
4. Guest switches language
5. Measure time for language switch
expected_results: Language detection completes in < 10ms
Content with translation loads in < 200ms
Language switch (client-side) completes in < 100ms
No perceived delay when toggling View Original

scenarios.title: Guest views SEO-optimized page with translated metadata

2. Page generates metadata for SEO

expected_results: Page title uses translated item name in German
Meta description uses translated item description
Canonical URL does NOT include language parameter
og:title and og:description use translated content

scenarios.title: Guest views full translation flow across multiple items
steps: 1. Guest scans QR code for Item A, views in French
2. Guest bookmarks Item A
3. Guest scans QR code for Item B (different property)
4. Item B also displays in French (cookie persists)
5. Guest changes to Spanish on Item B
6. Guest returns to Item A bookmark
expected_results: Language preference persists across different items
Cookie updates when guest changes language
Item A displays in Spanish (new preference) on return
Consistent language experience across entire site

scenarios.title: Guest requests unavailable translation
steps: 1. Guest's browser is set to Italian (it-IT)
2. Guest scans QR code for item
3. Item only has English and French translations (no Italian)
4. System detects Italian preference but no translation exists
expected_results: MissingTranslationBanner displays: 'Italian translation not available. Showing content in English.'
Content displays in original language (English)
GuestLanguageSwitcher shows Italian as grayed out but selectable
Guest can still select Italian (shows original content)

scenarios.title: Guest with unsupported language code

2. Swahili is not in supported languages list
3. Guest scans QR code
4. System attempts to map browser language
expected_results: mapToSupportedLanguage returns null for Swahili

No error is displayed to user
Content displays normally in original language

scenarios.title: Guest with malformed Accept-Language header

3. Guest visits item page
expected_results: parseAcceptLanguage handles malformed input gracefully
No exception is thrown
System falls back to default language
Page loads successfully with original content

scenarios.title: Guest with cookies blocked by browser
steps: 1. Guest has cookies blocked in browser settings
2. Guest scans QR code with French browser
3. Content displays in French (from Accept-Language)
4. Guest selects Spanish
5. Guest navigates away and returns
expected_results: Initial visit uses browser Accept-Language correctly
Language switch works during session
Cookie set attempt fails silently
On return, language is re-detected from Accept-Language
Experience is functional but not persistent

scenarios.title: Guest with partial translation (some fields missing)
steps: 1. Item has French translation for name only
2. Description translation is missing (null)
3. Guest views item in French
expected_results: Name displays in French (translated)
Description displays in original English (fallback)
mergeTranslation function handles partial translations
No error or broken display occurs

scenarios.title: Guest with complex Accept-Language header
steps: 1. Browser sends Accept-Language: 'de-DE,de;q=0.9,en-US;q=0.8,en;q=0.7,fr;q=0.6'
2. parseAcceptLanguage parses with quality weights
3. System determines best language match
expected_results: German (de) is selected as highest priority supported language
Quality weights are respected
Language variants (de-DE) map to base language (de)
Fallback chain works if primary not available

scenarios.title: Guest accesses item with very long translated content

2. Guest views item in German on mobile
3. Check layout with expanded text
expected_results: Layout handles longer German text without breaking
Text truncates with ellipsis where appropriate
No horizontal scrolling on mobile
Banner and buttons remain accessible

scenarios.title: Guest rapidly toggles between languages
steps: 1. Guest views item in English
2. Guest rapidly clicks: French -> German -> Spanish -> French
3. Multiple language changes in quick succession
expected_results: UI remains responsive during rapid changes
Final selected language is displayed correctly
Cookie reflects the last selected language
No race conditions or stale content

scenarios.title: Guest uses browser back button after language change
steps: 1. Guest visits /item/abc123 (shows in French from cookie)
2. Guest changes to Spanish, URL updates to /item/abc123?lang=es
3. Guest clicks browser back button
expected_results: URL returns to /item/abc123 (no lang param)
Content reverts to French (original cookie preference)
Browser history works correctly
No broken state after navigation

scenarios.title: Guest views item with pending translation status

expected_results: Pending translations are NOT shown to guests

Error is logged for monitoring

expected_results: Each guest receives correct language version

Caching (if implemented) works correctly

4. Monitor database query count and execution time
expected_results: Maximum 4 database queries: item, articles, links, tags

Batch fetching uses SQL JOIN or IN clause
Total query execution time < 50ms

scenarios.title: Guest switches from translated to original mid-read
steps: 1. Guest reads French translation of house rules
2. Guest scrolls to 'Noise Policy' section
3. Guest clicks 'View Original' toggle to clarify a term
4. Page scroll position is maintained
expected_results: Content switches to English instantly (client-side)
Scroll position remains at 'Noise Policy' section
No page reload or flash
Toggle button updates to 'View Translation'
Guest can toggle back to French

scenarios.title: Partial translation completion (Epic 3 workflow integration)
steps: 1. Owner submits item for German translation (Epic 3)
2. Translation job completes item name and description
3. Article translations still pending (status: 'pending')
4. Guest requests item in German
expected_results: Item name and description display in German
Articles display in original language (English)
No MissingTranslationBanner (partial translation is available)
TranslationBanner shows 'Translated from English' (item level)
Mixed language content is handled gracefully
